assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate arrhythmic events with neurological deficits
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to establish a definitive diagnosis and guide management
Supraventricular tachycardia is coded as I47.1
Transient cerebral ischemic attacks are coded as G45.9
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is coded as CPT 93247
The appeal addresses a denial code of PR-204
The denial relates to coverage limitations for diagnostic monitoring services
